row.title: DISCOVER-1: every Ultrastable system gets a knowledge graph and vector index that keeps finding connections
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-20: a vector database and knowledge graph are a hallmark of every system; QNFO's research graph worked and its table-scan cost did not. core/discover embeds changed items only (content hash), keeps int8 vectors in a packed index searched exactly in memory (Vectorize port above 20,000 vectors, because Vectorize bills (stored+1) x dimensions per query and the free allocation is 30M queried dimensions a month), builds a kNN graph with communities, proposes transfer, combination, bridge and frontier leads, screens novelty, settles each lead against what the system later adopts, and tunes one knob with a scored prediction. core/modelservice serves /embed behind OIDC, core/ask takes a semantic hook. Practical Solutions runs it daily (connections.yml) and shows it at /connections.
